items.title: Harry Shields Interview, 1961-05-28
items.q: By the way, Dick Allen, who works with us up at Tulane

ctx.x: See, Brown Lee, he was... That was his introduction to Peculiar Rank. Norman Brown Lee? Yeah. And of course, the other side was Sharky's tune. Let's see, what was the name of that? Dirty Rank. Oh, yeah. Yeah. So we decided that we'd use three names on both sides. But the verse and the chorus of Peculiar was really mine. And then later Sharky recorded it again, I think with Sidney Airdman and Mel Kaisel. So he told me about this. Well, go ahead. You can make a recording. Go ahead.

By the way, Dick Allen, who works with us up at Tulane, was over in Pensacola just two weeks ago and interviewed Norman Brown. Norman, did he? Said he's getting along fine. He's president of the union over there. I understand that.
